Gardinerus uicarius[?] Cancellarius, opulentissimi regni pestis & exitium, omnium Papistarum ac proditorum uocere[?] spondit, petitamq; eius populi perniciem admisit. Et gratias agendas esse patri sanctissimo (turpissimo Antichristo) pronunciauit, quod prophetam tam eximium, nempe Cardinalem purpuratum, ex ipsorum gente natum, & qui totum in utrunq; eorum exitium incumbat, ad illos miserit. Deinceps uoce omnium ueniam rogauit, pœnitudinem ad se clamauit, insignem remitti noxam petijt, reuersionem est pollicitus, solitam gratiam exegit, indulgentiam depoposcit, deprecatus est benedictionem, subiectionem obtulit, obedientiam porrexit, spopondit obsequium: & pro Anglica gente tota, quasi nouam professionem Romano diabolo fecit, perditissimus nebulo ac sordidissimus adulter: promittens in futuris comitiis, sanctissimarum legum Henrici & Eduardi plenissimam abolitionem. Hinc data à Deo potestate regia, ingenua ac libera, suc-cessuros sibi reges, fœminas parum officij obseruans,ut nihil dicam grauius,indignißime priuauit, atq; adulterinam quandam sub fcepticipite[?] bestia dynastiam cum fœdißimis eius sordibus, illius loco,ad plebis suae perniciem excepit. O infœlicißima natio,quae à salutari Christi gremio, in Satanae infernalis barathrum,indurata tua pertinacia,merito cecidisti. Propter peccata populi (inquit pijs-simus Iobus) regnare Deus hypocritam fecit. Impius ille spiritus, qui syncera diuini uerbi praedicatione à te exiuerat, cum septem alijs spiritibus se deterioribus, ad te nunc demum redijt, & apud te manet: fitq; tua posterior haec conditio, priore multo deterior. Misericordißimus pater Deus adre-sipiscentiam adhuc te semel prouocet, atq; hoc in Romanam tyrannidem uaticinium tandem adimpleat:
units.tr: Meanwhile Cardinal Pole arrived, the Mercury of the Roman devils, once cast out by King Henry his father because of Papism, and restored again by his daughter Mary for the same reason. Sent by the great pederast Julius, so that he might utterly bring ruin upon his country, both bodies and souls, he first asked that they return into communion with their Baal-Peor and again submit themselves to his authority, the most sacred Gospel of Christ having been abandoned. For there is no fellowship of justice with wickedness, nor communion of light with darkness. He promised kindness and clemency from his Antichrist, the most rapacious son of utter destruction. Gardiner, the vicar and chancellor, the plague and ruin of the most wealthy kingdom, promised the voices of all Papists and traitors and admitted their request for the destruction of this people. He declared that thanks should be given to the most holy father (the most shameful Antichrist) because he had sent to them such an outstanding prophet, namely a purple-robed Cardinal, born of their own race, who bends all his efforts to the ruin of both. Then, in the voice of all, he asked for pardon, cried out for repentance to himself, sought that a notable offence be remitted, promised a return, demanded the customary grace, begged for indulgence, implored a blessing, offered submission, extended obedience, and pledged obedience. And for the whole English nation he made, as it were, a new profession to the Roman devil, most desperate wretch and filthiest adulterer: promising at the future assemblies the most complete abolition of the most holy laws of Henry and Edward. Hence, having deprived of the regal power given by God, free and noble, the successors to the throne, women who observed little duty (to say nothing more severe), most unworthily, he received in its place a certain adulterous dynasty under the foul beast, with all its most foul filth, to the destruction of his own people. O most unhappy nation, which by your obstinacy has deservedly fallen from the saving bosom of Christ into the infernal abyss of Satan. "Because of the sins of the people," says the most pious Job, "God made a hypocrite to reign." That impious spirit, which had gone out from you through the sincere preaching of the divine Word, has now at last returned to you with seven other spirits worse than itself, and remains with you; and this your latter condition has become much worse than the former. May the most merciful Father God still once more call you to repentance, and at last fulfil this prophecy against the Roman tyranny: Rome, long staggering, driven by long errors, shall fall and cease to be the head of the world.

units.la: Roma diu titubans, longis erroribus acta Corruet, & mundi desinet esse caput.
units.tr: Rome, long tottering and driven by long errors, will fall and cease to be the head of the world.
